name: astral-orchestrator
description: Automatically chooses and coordinates GPT models for project tasks, with the right effort and safeguards for each job.

interface.longDescription: Astra leads Astral Orchestrator, which automatically chooses the right GPT models and how much effort each should use, then coordinates them as a team. Give it a goal and it breaks the work into focused tasks, runs independent tasks together when helpful, checks the results, and brings everything into one clear outcome. Simple jobs stay fast, while risky changes get extra safeguards, so you get finished, verified work without managing multiple agents yourself. Use any configured Astra effort in every mode. Worker effort is independent, so an Astra Light lead can launch Astra Max or Ultra workers. Explicitly choose Hypernova for maximum safe concurrency with Sol Ultra workers by default or selected Astra Max/Ultra workers.
defaultPrompt: Use Astral: Orbit default; Comet tiny; Event Horizon high-risk; Singularity one verified Astra session.
Use Astral in Pulsar, Morph, or Constellation mode for this explicit opt-in request.
Use Astral in Hypernova mode at my selected Astra effort, with Astra Ultra workers and fresh review. Verify each route.
